camel_example: aliyun alidns DescribeGtmAccessStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --StrategyId hra0hs --Lang en
description_en: Queries the details of an access policy based on the policy ID
description_zh: 根据策略ID获取策略详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-gtm-access-strategy --lang en --strategy-id hra0hs --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGtmAccessStrategy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access policy
parameters.name: strategy_id

AccessMode.description_en:
The switchover policy for the address pool groups:

AUTO: Automatic switchover

DEFAULT: Primary address pool group

FAILOVER: Secondary address pool group
AccessMode.description_zh:
地址池集合切换策略：

AUTO：自动切换
DEFAULT：主地址池集合
FAILOVER： 备地址池集合

AccessStatus.description_en:
The access status. Valid values:

DEFAULT: Normal. Access requests are routed to the primary address pool group.

FAILOVER: Abnormal. Access requests are routed to the secondary address pool group
AccessStatus.description_zh:
访问状态。其中：

DEFAULT：访问主地址池集合，表示正常
FAILOVER：访问备地址池集合，表示异常

DefaultAddrPoolMonitorStatus.description_en:
The health check status of the primary address pool group. Valid values:

OPEN: Enabled

CLOSE: Disabled

UNCONFIGURED: Not configured
DefaultAddrPoolMonitorStatus.description_zh:
主地址池集合健康检查状态。其中：

OPEN：开启
CLOSE：关闭
UNCONFIGURED：未配置

DefaultAddrPoolName.description_en: The name of the primary address pool group

DefaultAddrPoolStatus.description_en:
The availability status of the primary address pool group. Valid values:

AVAILABLE: The address pool group is available.

NOT_AVAILABLE: The address pool group is unavailable
DefaultAddrPoolStatus.description_zh:
主地址池集合可用状态。其中：

AVAILABLE：可用
NOT_AVAILABLE：不可用

DefultAddrPoolId.description_en: The ID of the primary address pool group

FailoverAddrPoolId.description_en: The ID of the secondary address pool group. If no secondary address pool group is configured, EMPTY is returned
FailoverAddrPoolId.description_zh:
备地址池集合ID。
若未设置备地址池集合，传值EMPTY

FailoverAddrPoolMonitorStatus.description_en:
The health check status of the secondary address pool group. Valid values:

OPEN: Enabled

CLOSE: Disabled

UNCONFIGURED: Not configured
FailoverAddrPoolMonitorStatus.description_zh:
备地址池集合健康检查状态。其中：

OPEN：开启
CLOSE：关闭
UNCONFIGURED：未配置

FailoverAddrPoolName.description_en: The name of the secondary address pool group

FailoverAddrPoolStatus.description_en:
The availability status of the secondary address pool group. Valid values:

AVAILABLE: The address pool group is available.

NOT_AVAILABLE: The address pool group is unavailable
FailoverAddrPoolStatus.description_zh:
备地址池集合可用状态。其中：

AVAILABLE：可用
NOT_AVAILABLE：不可用

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the associated Global Traffic Manager (GTM) instance

Line.description_en: The list of source regions for DNS requests

GroupCode.description_en: The code of the source region group for DNS requests
GroupCode.description_zh: 解析请求来源分组编码

GroupName.description_en: The name of the source region group for DNS requests
GroupName.description_zh: 解析请求来源分组名称

LineCode.description_en: The code of the source region for DNS requests

LineName.description_en: The name of the source region for DNS requests

StrategyMode.description_en: The policy mode. SELF_DEFINED indicates a custom policy
StrategyMode.description_zh:
策略模式
SELF_DEFINED 自定义

StrategyName.description_en: The name of the access policy
